name: Handles, Jumpers & Slides
summary: Tighten your handle, groove a rhythm jumper, cut off drives on defense, then finish tired at game speed.

drills.name: Pocket-to-Rip Dribbles
drills.summary: Protect the ball low, then rip it across your body fast.
steps: Get in a low stance and pound 10 hard dribbles with your right hand.
Pull the ball into your hip pocket and hold it for one count.
Rip it low across your body and pound 10 with your left.
Keep going side to side for 2 minutes.
Last minute: rip into one hard dribble and an explosive first step each way.

drills.name: Three-Spot Rhythm Jumpers
drills.summary: Catch on a hop and shoot the same shot from three spots.
steps: Set cones at the right elbow, top of the key and left elbow.
Stand 2 steps behind a cone and spin the ball out in front of you.
Hop into the catch with your feet set and shoot.
Make 3 at a spot before you move to the next cone.
Go around all three spots twice.

drills.name: Sideline Wall-Off Slides
drills.summary: Slide hard and cut off the drive before it turns the corner.
steps: Set two cones 4 big steps apart along the sideline.
Get in stance facing the court, top foot a little higher than the other.
Slide cone to cone without crossing your feet.
At each cone, drop your hip and stab your hand out like you're cutting off a drive.
Work 30 seconds, rest 15, and repeat for 3 minutes.

drills.name: Corner-to-Corner Burst Layups
drills.summary: Speed dribble, change direction and finish strong when your legs are tired.
steps: Start in the right corner with the ball.
Speed dribble to the top of the key, plant hard and attack the left side of the rim.
Finish a left-hand layup, grab the rebound and dribble out to the left corner.
Repeat the other way and finish with your right hand.
Go 40 seconds on, 20 seconds rest for 4 rounds. Count your makes and beat it each round.
